prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer for every Dallas home, but **Arrington Roofing** looks like a strong first company to get a quote from: it’s Dallas-based, has operated since 1983, reports a 4.9-star rating from 350+ reviews, and says it is GAF Master Elite certified. It handles full roof replacements. [Arrington Roofing](https://arringtonroofing.com/)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **New View Roofing**, which reports GAF Master Elite certification and extensive DFW experience. [New View Roofing](https://newviewroofing.com/)

Before choosing, compare at least three **written, itemized** bids. Check that each includes the same materials and scope, proof of insurance, cleanup and disposal, permit responsibility, and specific workmanship and manufacturer warranty terms. Verify any certification and recent reviews independently, and don’t feel pressured to sign after a storm inspection.
